content.text: Six-second single live-action historical film shot. Match this composition exactly. The valley fire is ALREADY burning at its maximum in the FIRST frame. A violent downpour is already striking the whole valley. During seconds0—4 the visible orange flame area steadily SHRINKS under the rain: tall tongues become short flickers, then the LAST flicker dies. Seconds4—6 show only dark soaked wood and white steam in the valley, NO orange flames remaining. No ignition, no new flare, no explosion. Dense wind-driven rain streaks pass the foreground, heavy drops splash on the cliff. Zhuge Liang remains at left watching downward, soaked robe moves in gusts, mouth closed. Camera slowly pushes toward the extinguishing valley. Physical rain and smothering fire, not a fantasy spectacle. Sound only heavy rain and wind, fire hiss diminishing to rain. No speech, no narration, no music. Full-frame16:9.
